captions.detailed: A realistic bicycle crankset and pedal assembly, featuring a central bottom-bracket shell with simulated frame tube stubs, dual light-grey crank arms, a black chainring with a multi-spoke spider, and two black rectangular cage pedals. The crank arms are arranged 180 degrees apart, and both pedals are mounted on axles at the ends of the crank arms. The assembly allows continuous rotation of the crank arms relative to the fixed bottom-bracket frame, while each pedal can rotate independently on its axle.
captions.instruction: Create a realistic bicycle crankset and pedal assembly. The model should include a bottom-bracket shell with frame tube stubs, two crank arms oriented 180 degrees apart, a multi-spoke spider holding a toothed black chainring, and two cage-style pedals that can rotate freely on their axles.
captions.factory: The assembly is constructed using multiple parts. The fixed frame part consists of a cylinder for the bottom-bracket shell and intersecting cylinders representing frame tube stubs. The rotating drivetrain part is built by combining a central spindle cylinder, two crank arms (created by extruding a rounded slot profile), a multi-spoke spider, and a chainring with modeled gear teeth. Two separate pedal parts are constructed as rectangular frames with internal cross-bars and are attached to the crank arms via continuous revolute joints along the pedal axle axes.
